issues.description: Inconsistent return type for Animal.messageOnFeed(): the problem statement/UML specifies `messageOnFeed(): String`, but the solution defines `Animal.messageOnFeed()` to return `FeedResponse` and implements `Pig.messageOnFeed()`/`Seal.messageOnFeed()` with `FeedResponse`, while `Goat.messageOnFeed()` returns `String`. This makes the reference implementation internally inconsistent and contradicts the required API that students are expected to implement (and that Farm song/feeding output assumes is directly printable as a String).
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one signature and apply it consistently across statement/UML/template/solution. Recommended: keep the spec as-is and change `Animal.messageOnFeed()` to return `String` and update Pig/Seal to return `String` (remove/avoid `FeedResponse`). Alternatively, if `FeedResponse` is intended, update the UML/task text/template to `messageOnFeed(): FeedResponse` and update Goat to return `FeedResponse` as well.
